tools.name: tailnet_status
tools.description: Report the state of the local tailnet: this node plus all peers with hostname, MagicDNS name, Tailscale IPv4/IPv6, OS, online flag, last seen, exit-node flags, and tags. Returns a structured error with the exact fix command when the tailscale binary is missing, the daemon is stopped, or the device needs login.

onlineOnly.description: Only include peers that are currently online (default: false)

tools.name: generate_ssh_config
tools.description: Generate ssh-config Host blocks for tailnet nodes (MagicDNS name preferred, Tailscale IP fallback). Dry-run by default: returns the generated config text only and writes nothing. With write=true it writes a dedicated file (~/.ssh/tailscale_dev_config) and returns instructions for adding an Include line to ~/.ssh/config (never applied automatically). Direct editing of ~/.ssh/config itself additionally requires target="user_ssh_config" and is idempotent between managed markers, never touching content outside them.

write.description: Actually write the config (default: false = dry-run, text only)

target.description: Write target: "dedicated_file" (default, ~/.ssh/tailscale_dev_config) or "user_ssh_config" (edit ~/.ssh/config between managed markers)

onlineOnly.description: Only include peers that are currently online (default: false)

includeShared.description: Include nodes of users this node is shared with (default: false). Mullvad exit nodes are always skipped.

user.description: Remote user to set on every Host block

tools.name: share_status
tools.description: Report the active Tailscale Serve/Funnel sessions on this node: one entry per endpoint with its URL, serve port, mount path, proxied target, and a public flag that is true when Funnel exposes it to the open internet. publicExposure is true when anything is public.

tools.name: share_port
tools.description: Share a local port over the tailnet via Tailscale Serve (tailnet-only by default). WARNING: setting public=true switches to Funnel and exposes the port to the OPEN INTERNET — anyone with the URL can reach it. Only set public=true when internet exposure is explicitly intended. Funnel is DISABLED on this server: public=true returns FUNNEL_DISABLED unless the user sets TAILSCALE_MCP_ALLOW_FUNNEL=1. Returns the resulting URL(s).

public.description: Expose to the open internet via Funnel (default: false = tailnet-only Serve). DANGEROUS: public=true makes the port reachable by anyone on the internet. Disabled unless TAILSCALE_MCP_ALLOW_FUNNEL=1.

path.description: HTTPS mount path on the serve endpoint, e.g. "/api" (default: "/")

tools.name: stop_share
tools.description: Stop sharing. Name exactly one target: httpsPort and/or path turns off that one mount (httpsPort is the serve port shown in share_status, typically 443, not the proxied local port; path is the mount path given to share_port, default "/"); mine=true stops only the shares this server created in this session; all=true clears the entire serve/funnel configuration, including shares set up outside this server. With no arguments nothing is stopped and the active endpoints are listed. Returns what was removed and what remains.

httpsPort.description: HTTPS serve port of the mount to turn off (default 443 when path is given)

path.description: Mount path to turn off, as passed to share_port (default: "/")

mine.description: Stop only the shares created by share_port in this session

all.description: Clear the ENTIRE serve/funnel config, including shares not created by this server

tools.name: ping_all
tools.description: Ping tailnet peers concurrently (bounded to 5 at a time, with a per-ping timeout) and return a latency matrix: node, latency ms of the settled path, path (direct, DERP relay, or peer relay), or unreachable. Defaults to online peers only. The whole call is capped at 45s; peers not answered by then are reported with an error and timedOut is true.

onlineOnly.description: Only ping peers reported online (default: true)
